verdict.rationale: Jeeves's only receivables-side evidence is its Boleto API, which lets clients create, retrieve, extend and cancel boletos (Brazilian payment slips) with Bolepix Pix QR codes for instant collection. That is a narrow, API-only, Brazil-specific form of payment-request creation with built-in collection. The other invoice mentions (invoice payments and approval flows, smart invoice scanning, bill-pay invoices) concern paying incoming vendor bills, not issuing invoices, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: a general invoice creation tool, branding or customization of invoices, sending or delivering invoices to customers, payment collection outside boleto/Pix, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
